title: Why a Perfect Railroad Can Fail
description:
Learn why railroad tracks have gaps, how thermal expansion works, and why perfect train tracks can buckle in the heat.

Free guide to this video (steps and every source): https://studio.golidee.com/guides/golide-short-2026-11-23.pdf

Two companies race to build a railroad across a canyon, but the smoother track may hide a dangerous problem. When summer arrives, the clickety-clack railroad reveals why those gaps were there.

#Railroad #TrainTracks #ThermalExpansion #Railway #TrainFacts #Engineering #RailroadHistory
